integrity: Verify every current component SHA and current publication bytes in both paths; receipts may skip parsing and per-row semantic checks only. No source payload rehash in synthetic reads; real retained verification in regression.
outcomes: Safe semantic reuse with explicit residual integrity/membership work
Reject shortcuts missing any oracle rejection
Defer savings if trust/selection overhead dominates
previousCost: All 48 scoped builds/audits inspect 2048 records, including two-record changes. Ordinary files still require current integrity/availability checks.
publication: Direct memberships, existing proof fixed32-byte eligibility trie, atomic current/eligibility root, single sequential writer. No parent traversal.
scientific: Synthetic metadata validation controls only; retained native qualifiers stay pinned. No new physical observations/results.
trust: Explicit root hash supplied by trusted local verifier after full acceptance; no root obtained from candidate. Receipt hash is integrity, not proof of issuer authority. Fresh processes take externally pinned anchor. Compromised verifier/anchor excluded.
uncertainty: Whether immutable component-local semantic validation can be reused with oracle-equivalent contextual/publication checks, and whether trust/selection overhead repays it.
